nextStoryContext: US-001 added onProgress to loop.ts (ProgressPayload, OnProgress types exported). The template now has active/iteration as dynamic placeholders ({{ACTIVE}}, {{ITERATION}}) plus four new fields. parseStateFile in status.ts parses the new optional fields. The live progress writer in next.ts uses writeFileSync(writtenPath, ...) to rewrite in place; terminal call calls unlinkSync(writtenPath). All existing tests pass unchanged.
